paragraphs: Lendable’s goal of instant credit and savings mirrors my work on a fast‑acting agentic tool that delivers real‑time decisions for a Madrid‑based start‑up.
I proposed and prototyped an MCP‑based agentic tool in Python, using FastMCP, Ollama gpt‑oss:20b, PostgreSQL and GitHub Actions CI, and presented it in a live stakeholder demo.
I wrote a three‑tier test framework of about 65 tests across eight files, validating the LLM provider migration from Groq to AWS Bedrock after a rate‑limit evaluation.
